text:
Ava: Quick PRD draft for the 1-pager is up. Need small, punchy one-pager that sales can drop into field decks — focused on security + SLA choices across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Link: https://docs.google.com/... (internal)
Miguel: Nice. Can we have a side-by-side table showing tradeoffs: latency, cost predictability, data isolation? one line each
Priya: +1. Also include recommended customer signals (when to pick Dedicated vs Private) — it'll help sales
Sam: FR: Add a short benchmark blurb: p95/p99 latency numbers for typical convo loads, and cost per 1k tokens estimates
Ava: Draft updated. Pinged @jen for compliance copy. Also added a "what to ask the customer" checklist
jen: I added language around KMS/HSM and SOC2 Type II. Keep it customer-facing, not legalese.
Miguel: For webinar spin: 10min slide on 'how we keep apps online during regional outages' — short story + fallback routing diagram
Priya: Can we reuse the inbound routing webhook playbook? Need an ops snippet showing canary rollout and automatic fallback policy
Ava: I'll pull the routing flow from the ops deck and make a compact diagram.
Sam: For benchmarks: can someone pull the 10k msg/day e-commerce workload numbers and a 50k/day finserv sample? We need both
Miguel: I have finserv numbers in the shared sheet — will paste in. Also adding a 2-line bullet on quantization tradeoffs
jen: Also tag with compliance audience: "CISO pocket brief" and include a one-sentence SLA guarantee and escalation path
Ava: Proposed CTA: "Schedule a field demo" + checklist to qualify for Dedicated trial. Thoughts?
Priya: Good. Also create a short version for webinar registration landing — 3 bullets only
Miguel: I'll create two CSVs for inbound routing tags so SalesOps can auto-tag leads by deploy interest (hosted/dedicated/private)
Sam: Timeline? Need final one-pager by Friday EOD for ops to feed into the webinar promo.
Ava: Targeting Friday. I'll drop the draft here in the morning. Thanks team :rocket:
deploy-bot: Note: doc linked in thread was updated 3 hours ago by Ava
Ava: Draft uploaded: https://docs.google.com/draft-onepager (internal)
jen: Quick review later today, will leave inline comments
Priya: I'll write the 'customer signals' micro-copy after Jen's compliance tweaks
Miguel: I'll flatten the benchmark numbers into a 1-line 'typical economics' section
Sam: I'll prepare the 1-minute talking points for the webinar host
Ava: Perfect. Next check-in: Thursday 11am. I'll create the calendar invite.
Priya: Adding webinar promo snippets to this thread as soon as ready
Ava: Thanks all — closing loop once comments are in. :white_check_mark:
